output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

SHE'S COMING!!! 🎉🎉🎉 Her NMC PIN came through today and I am literally crying in the clinic car park, I can't even type properly 😭😭

@Lorna Villaruz, my best friend of almost 30 years, is now officially a UK registered nurse and she is coming to Liverpool!!! 🇵🇭➡️🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿

Okay let me tell you the story. Lorna and I trained together in nursing school in Iloilo, capping ceremony 1996 (yes, I'm telling everyone how old we are, sorry not sorry haha). In our dorm we polished our white shoes every night and she ALWAYS borrowed my polish. Never bought her own, not once!! Lorna, I want my polish back, 30 years of interest 😂

Then she worked in Riyadh and Dubai for almost 18 years, looking after so many patients and families far from home. And when I left for the UK in 2004, she cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." I have been telling her to come ever since. TWENTY YEARS of "Lorna, come na!" And now, 22 years later, she is finally following me, haha. Better late than never, ha? ❤️

She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into 🌧️ She said she was not scared. We will see, mare, we will see 😂

She flies from Dubai on 14 January and lands in Manchester around 1pm, and I will be at the airport with a sign and a very loud voice, sorry in advance to everyone around us. She starts work on 25 January on Ward 7. Ward 7, you don't know it yet but you are so lucky!! She is the best nurse I know. Calm, kind, never panics, and the patients just love her. I have seen it with my own eyes. Look after her, please, and let her teach you a few things too 😉

She will stay with us for her first month in our spare room. Ben says ok!! (Ben did not really have a choice, haha, I love you mahal.) So now I must clean the room, find the thickest duvet in Liverpool and buy a heater, because she will freeze.

Lorna, a few things before you come:
1. Bring a PROPER COAT. Not a "nice" coat, a proper coat. Liverpool wind is not a joke, it will go right through you and take your wig with it 😂
2. Bring your appetite, because we eat a lot here.
3. Do not bring your own shoe polish. I'm kidding, bring some, you owe me.

And to all my Filipino family here in Liverpool, please welcome her with open arms. We have the Christmas parties, the potluck (please, not ten pancit again), the karaoke, and next year Simbang Gabi together, all nine nights, and she is coming with us. You are not alone here, mare. We are your family now, and we will make sure you have everything you need.

I am so proud of you, Lorna. Two years of papers, exams, waiting and praying, and you did it. You really did it. Thank you Lord for answering our prayers, and thank you Lorna for keeping your promise from that airport 22 years ago. 😭❤️

See you very soon, my sister from another mother. Liverpool is ready for you (the wind is not, but you will be fine) 🤗

Congratulations again, Registered Nurse Villaruz!!! 👩‍⚕️🎉

#NMCPIN #WelcomeLorna #FilipinoNursesUK #Liverpool #BestFriendForever
